verdict.rationale: Shopify runs a live cross-merchant Global Catalog MCP/UCP endpoint (catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp) confirmed via keyless runtime probes to return real search_catalog/lookup_catalog/get_product results across merchants, plus per-merchant storefront UCP endpoints, and publishes an agent-facing llms.txt and markdown docs — directly delivering cross-merchant AI-agent discoverability. missing for 10: independent (non-Shopify) reporting confirming answer-engine adoption/usage of this feed in the wild, and clarity on how broadly merchants are enrolled by default vs opt-in.
